title: Great experience, very relaxing. despite the choppy sea.
text: Conveniently located on Barceloneta beach, friendly and welcoming staff. Good facilities (showers and changing rooms). Equipment provided was good quality, with instructions provided on how to use it. Clearly marked area in which to paddle board.
author: Alex_W

title: Great experience
text: It was super nice to be on a stand-up paddleboard at sunrise, I can highly recommend it.
author: stellakS7664XO

title: Hooked on SUP!
text: We had so much fun.  It was our first time and we loved it.  Sephora was so helpful with our instructions and accommodations.   Please ask for her, she was great.
author: Sunshine_N

title: First time on a paddle board. Not the last.
text: Overall a wonderful experience! We weren't with any tour. I can't remember if Sea You was recommended or whether we chose it for its location (a reputation for cleaner water at that section of the beach) or price (reasonable), but we were all glad that we found it. Three of us rented paddle boards for an hour, two of us for the very first time. From beginning to end the staff made us feel welcome; they were kind, very engaged with the business, allowed us to store our bags with them, spoke a variety of languages, and in general couldn't have been more helpful. It made a great start to our hour
author: 812katharineh

title: Great time at the beach!
text: Great experience and the owners were super helpful to get us prepared to go paddle board. Also incredibly detailed.
author: cliffk851

title: Great experience!
text: Staff were very friendly. As well as supper helpful and gave us hints to help as well as providing some extra time. Highly recommend.
author: Zachary_G

title: ideal for a bachelor party
text: Great experience recommended by Luigi Barchini of the Harem Barcelona group during our stay in the city '. We performed this splendid activity during a bachelor party celebration. We were delighted with the service and had a great time. The sunny day helped a lot. Incredible staff
author: danielcJ4530IU

title: Surf the Spanish waves 😎
text:
On Saturday 2 November, the wind was blowing at more than 25km/h and conditions were not favourable for paddle paddling because there were sheep in the water. 

So I had the chance to observe a team that knows how to adapt.
I was offered to participate in a surf session for another 20th (of souvenir). Which I accepted because I had planned the morning for. The team was able to speak in Spanish and English.

So I joined a team of 3 people plus the Lubi instructor (sorry Lubi I wrote your name badly), who took care of us during the whole session (2 good hours in total).

title: Great place for paddle surf

title: Cool atmosphere, good quality surfs, kind staff
text: We really liked the place - did not have to wait, the staff was quick and nice, explained everything well. The atmosphere is cool and chill. The surfs are very good quality.
